channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's vulnerability landscape is dominated by critical flaws in network devices and web applications, presenting significant exploitation risks across multiple sectors. Router manufacturers D-Link and DrayTek face numerous high-severity issues including buffer overflows, hardcoded credentials, and remote command injection that allow unauthenticated attackers to compromise devices or execute arbitrary code. Web platforms such as PrestaShop, AcyMailing, and Document Library Pro suffer from authentication bypasses, blind SQL injection, and unsafe deserialization that threaten sensitive data and system control. Furthermore, cloud orchestration software like Linux Foundation Magma and middleware components including Apache Shiro and Cyrus SASL exhibit authentication weaknesses that could enable unauthorized access across distributed environments.

item.title: CVE-2026-123962 — Desktop OS
item.description: Symlink manipulation in FreedomBox allows unprivileged users to read and write restricted system files, escalating local privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-129360 — Cloud Security
item.description: Manipulation of client certificate serial numbers in Linux Foundation Magma bypasses authentication for the 5G core network.

item.title: CVE-2026-129359 — Cloud Security
item.description: Hard-coded credentials in Magma registry interceptors undermine secure communication within cloud-native orchestration layers.

item.title: CVE-2026-124560 — Network Devices
item.description: Heap-based buffer overflow in the D-Link DIR-878 HNAP handler enables remote attackers to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2026-129354 — Network Devices
item.description: Stack-based buffer overflow in the D-Link DIR-600L HNAP component allows unauthenticated remote exploitation.

item.title: CVE-2026-129444 — Network Devices
item.description: Hard-coded credentials in the D-Link DSL-6740C FTP daemon completely bypass authentication mechanisms.

item.title: CVE-2026-129449 — Network Devices
item.description: Remote command injection in DrayTek Vigor2960 firmware allows attackers to execute system commands without authorization.

item.title: CVE-2026-129451 — Network Devices
item.description: Path traversal flaw in DrayTek Vigor2960 file export functions exposes sensitive internal system configurations.

item.title: CVE-2026-125795 — Web Security
item.description: Blind SQL injection in the AcyMailing plugin allows attackers to extract sensitive database contents without direct feedback.

item.title: CVE-2026-125769 — Web Security
item.description: Incorrect privilege assignment in Advanced Form Integration enables unauthenticated users to escalate to administrative roles.

item.title: CVE-2026-122662 — Web Security
item.description: Untrusted deserialization in Document Library Pro triggers object injection, potentially leading to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-71531 — Web Security
item.description: Authorization flaws in the PrestaShop Webservice API allow attackers to bypass shop isolation and access restricted merchant data.

item.title: CVE-2026-129464 — Web Security
item.description: Path traversal vulnerability in Zr.Admin.NET permits authenticated users to read arbitrary server files, including JWT configurations.

item.title: CVE-2026-129483 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Flawed validation in Cyrus SASL SRP mechanism allows unauthenticated clients to force zero shared secrets and bypass login.

item.title: CVE-2026-129349 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Insecure LDAP authentication caching in Apache Shiro skips credential verification after the first successful login attempt.
